items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Oh good, we had no problems. I used to call him uncle. He used to call me Grimey Joe... We had a good time. We had no problems.

ctx.x: So, you got along well with Tatum?

Oh good, we had no problems. I used to call him uncle. He used to call me Grimey Joe, Grimey Joe. All the time Grimey or Grimey Joe I said, 'All right uncle'. You're my uncle.' He didn't like me say 'I ain't your uncle.' We had a good time. We had no problems. Never. The whole time I was with that group

I missed -- I was late once. I just overslept. I didn't have a clock. We were in Washington at the Howard Theater and boy when I woke up, I said "oh no" mmhm. I did it, finally did it, and when I got there, they was on the stage. Ain't nobody said a word though. They didn't chastise me, they didn't say a word. I wish they had something -- ha ha, they knew it wasn't no habit of mine, they knew that something was wrong. I just didn't get up. But that was the only time. I'd always be the first one downstairs…
